name: Saito Nissha
source:
Coworker of the convenience store Kudo works at, he is a pompous jerk who looks down on him and doesn’t mind using physical violence. 
He is a womanizer who sees all females as objects. After seeing Alphiel, he doesn’t hesitate to try to find a way to make her his.
